verdicts.reason: The two candidates are practically identical leaderboard strips with the same flaws. The RSVP CTA has shrunk into a pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges, so it no longer stands out. The 'Reserve a spot' URL sits under the logo, far from its button. The 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' eyebrow is cut off from the headline and pushed to the far right. The time/venue line wraps to leave 'Pier 9' orphaned on its own line, and the red placeholder image collides with that text. The microscopic italic subhead and venue copy can't be read at this size. The only difference is a tiny shift in the logo's position, which doesn't change any of this.
